strings.en:
The Inspectors, aliens who used force to intervene
in the Earth Sphere...
Neo DC, the military group that rebelled against
the Earth Federation Government...
Shadow Mirror, the special forces from a parallel
world who conspired with them from the shadows...
And the mysterious bioweapons, the Einst.

Their main forces were destroyed by the Hagane,
the Hiryu Custom and the Kurogane, battleships
of the Earth Federation Army.

The series of conflicts that would later be called
the Inspector Incident came to an end, and the
Earth Sphere was beginning to regain its peace.

Taking its repeated battles with alien intelligences
as a lesson, the Earth Federation Government decided
to further strengthen Project Aegis, which aimed to
reorganize and reinforce the Earth Federation Army.

As part of this, manufacturers were asked to
develop a new mass-production mainstay unit to
succeed the Mass-Production Huckebein Mk-II,
and a competitive trial would be held.
But no one had realized...

that the invaders from another world were not gone...
and that they had been active since the final days
of the Inspector Incident.
Now, the bells of a new war begin to toll.

The Cry Wolves, the Earth Federation Army's 3rd Special Ops PT
Unit, are assigned to guard the Earth Cradle. On the orders of
Dr. Mitar Zapad, head of the Tsentr Project, a development plan
for mass-production mobile weapons focused on autonomous action
and maintenance-free operation, Captain Albero, along with his
subordinate Hugo and his son Foglia, captures the Einst Regisseur.

At the request of Dr. Eric Wang, also of the Tsentr Project, the
Cry Wolves head to the White Star to recover the spatial transfer
device installed in Shadow Mirror's super robot, the Zweizergain.
Infiltrating the core, Hugo's team recovers the wreckage of a
super robot they find there and escape the White Star...

Kota Azuma, a high schooler in Asakusa, is caught in a sudden
attack by a mysterious enemy and finds himself in dire straits.
To protect his town and his sister Shoko, Kota accepts Roa, the
warrior who appeared in his dreams, and transforms into Fighter
Roar. Meanwhile, his grandfather Kisaburo launches the Compatible
Kaiser, entrusted to him by Roa, to rescue Kota...

Two unknown units calling themselves Shura appear at the same
time and attack Kota. With help from Kai and the others who
sortie, Kota succeeds in driving the enemy out of Asakusa. His
grandfather Kisaburo then reveals that Kota was chosen by Roa,
a warrior from another world, to protect this world.

At an Earth Federation Army ceremony in Harumi unveiling its new
mainstay units, the Bartoll, the army's next-generation mainstay
unit, suddenly runs amok. In the chaos, Shoko, who was at the
venue, is abducted by Folka of the Shura, while Kusuha, Lamia
and others are carried off by the Bartolls.

The ODE System turns abducted people into bio-cores for mobile
weapons and controls them via a Master Core. To shut down this
system, developed by Dr. Jurgen, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom
attempt to storm his base, Hellgate. The group rescues Kusuha
and the others who had been placed aboard Bartolls, then pushes
into Hellgate.

Inside Hellgate, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom find their path
blocked by Lamia, who has been made a Bartoll bio-core. But
moments after her rescue seems to succeed, she falls at the
hands of Dr. Jurgen, whose mind has been consumed by the ODE
System. After a fierce battle, the group destroys the Master
Core. But then, a new and mysterious enemy appears...

With the Federation fleet's nuclear strike on Hellgate drawing
near, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom are forced to withdraw...

The Shura make their stronghold in Sordean, a colossal structure
that appeared near Hellgate. The Shura Generals, each a match for
a thousand, and Shura King Alcaid, who commands them, launch
attacks on Earth's bases to seize control of the Earth Sphere.
Meanwhile, the Earth Federation Army can find no effective way to
deal with Sordean, which is protected by a barrier.

The Earth Sphere is thrown into chaos by the Shura invasion.
Axel Almer, formerly of Shadow Mirror, is awakened by a familiar
voice. He and his Soulgain had been transferred to a Tsentr
Project laboratory. Left all alone, asking himself what reason he
has to live, Axel hears a girl's voice speaking directly into his
mind.

Mitar's experiments turned the Einst Regisseur into the Jetzt
Regisseur. The Jetzt runs wild, and the Cry Wolves, ordered to
recapture it, are driven into a corner. Axel boards the Soulgain
and throws himself into the fray once more...

Albero resolves to annihilate the Jetzt. With help from Shu's
Granzon, which happens to appear, the Jetzt is driven back.
Resolved to see where a world full of chaos and strife will end
up, Axel sets off with Alchemie after the fleeing Jetzt.

Through contact with Shoko, Folka begins to doubt the Shura way
of life: that power is everything. On the verge of handing Shoko
over to Duminas, he resolves to cast aside the name of Shura.
Against Folka, the traitor who fled with Shoko, the strategist
Mizal dispatches Fernando, Folka's fellow disciple...

Folka stands against Fernando to protect Shoko, but in an
unguarded moment, Shoko is taken once again. Exhausted from the
fight, Folka is taken in by the Kurogane, where he meets Shoko's
brother Kota and their grandfather Kisaburo, and he resolves to
rescue her.

As if in response to an unknown that appeared at the Tesla Reich
Institute, the slumbering RyuOhKi and KoOhKi have awakened. Dr.
Eri Anzai of the LTR Organization speculates that the Yokijin--
enemies of the Chokijin built in ancient China, destroyed in a
battle long ago--may have returned. It portends a new upheaval.

Duminas has finally obtained one of the Keys: Shoko. As Kota and
the others fight to save her, a mysterious black unit appears
before them. It resonates with the Compatible Kaiser and begins
to glow...

Kota is stunned to learn that the pilot of the mysterious black
unit, the G-Thundergate, is his sister Shoko. Cornered, Raul and
his team are rescued by Axel and Alchemie. Against Kyosuke and
the others who rush to help, Duminas sends the repaired Lamia...

With Axel's help, Kyosuke and the others succeed in retrieving
Lamia. Meanwhile, Roa, having learned that the G-Thundergate
serves Duminas, fears an encounter with his nemesis, Dark Brain.

Folka faces his sworn brother Altis the Flash, the mightiest
of the Shura Generals. Then Shoko appears in the
G-Thundergate as Fighter Emmy. Amid the battle, Kota keeps
trying to reach Shoko...

Shoko is freed from Duminas's mind control, and the
Compatible Kaiser and G-Thundergate combine into the
G-Compatible Kaiser. With Shoko finally back, Kota
drives off Tis and Duminas's other followers.

The Cry Wolves attack to destroy the Jetzt Regisseur that
escaped the institute. But the Jetzt Regisseur, energized by
the RBE rounds Mitar entrusted to them, kills Foglia as he
shields his father Albero. Hugo is left near death, and
the Cry Wolves are wiped out.

Using Dagger, a captured Shura transfer device, Operation
Overgate, the assault on Sordean, begins. The Hagane and
Hiryu Custom successfully warp inside Sordean. Battling
Fernando, Folka brings Ialdabaoth to its divine form.

The Hagane and Hiryu Custom push deep into Sordean, while
the Shura Generals and Shura King Alcaid try to stop them.
With fate at stake, the two sides clash. Defeated, the Shura
King entrusts the future of the Shura to Folka.

Having repelled the Shura, the Hagane and Hiryu Custom storm
Sordean's core, the Inner Sanctum, where Duminas moves to
eliminate them. Then Dark Brain, Roa's nemesis and the
creator of Duminas, appears...

Kota's team mounts a final battle against the Dark Wisdom,
which seeks to eradicate all intelligent life. After a
desperate struggle, Dark Brain is destroyed, and the threat
to the Earth Sphere seems to be gone...

But Masaki's fears prove true, and Shu Shirakawa finally
bares his fangs. After a hard fight, Masaki's team wins,
and Shu accepts his fate and vanishes into the rift
between dimensions.

At last, the fighting is over.
Amid the crossing hopes of many,
Folka, heir to the Shura King,
departs with Sordean in search
of a new world...
